reviews.review: Need more people online is my only complaint. When it first came out this game was crowded. But now it can be difficult to find players. My suggestion is to friend some players to play with or find a peak time in your area. You do only need two other dudes but it can be tricky now. It honestly a sick game even if you gust play it for the first run through on your own which you have to do before the multiplayer.

I've played for 60+ hours and enjoy this one. Unfortunately the current build v1.0.1 is unplayable. The game freezes regularly for 5+ seconds, finding a match is hard because everyone knows it's broken, and if you do manage to get a group you get randomly disconnected before finishing.

So if they ever fix this I would highly recommend the game. Until then, don't waste your money.

First, a preface: i play this with a friend, and find it's just not very much fun in single-player. If you're not going to play this with someone else, ideally someone you enjoy gaming with who is on voice with you, it will probably not be much fun. This is a game to be played multiplayer, and the single-player options are a stopgap at best.

I don't really understand why this game's core loop works so well for me, but it does. Once you're past the learn-the-game difficulty levels and consistently playing on Intense, there's something about the experience that becomes almost zen. The massive variety of guns, the special abilities and consumables, all contribute to the gameplay, but even without those there's just something about the core loop of play that I can repeat essentially forever.

This isn't to say that I wouldn't appreciate a lot more levels and encounters. The DLC was a welcome addition but I'd also be content with just a lot more station and hive levels, built from the same assets, with different configurations of enemies and encounter triggers. Still, the existing levels have enough potential variation in them, with optional routes and branches that the game may throw at you, to keep them somewhat fresh.

but really, it all comes down to the core loop of 'big swarm arrives, you kill them all, you check your status and resources and try to prep for the next swarm'.

and the sound of the smart gun, of course. if you see the smart gun fire and hear the sound and your immediate reaction is to say 'Let's rock!' then you'll appreciate this game's attention to the little details of verisimilitude. It honestly feels like being in an Aliens spinoff, and its Prometheus-inspired sections are almost enough to redeem Prometheus for me.

Anyway, highly recommended if you're an Aliens fan and you have an Aliens fan friend who would like to go on another bug hunt with you.

This game is really fun to play WITH FRIENDS. If ya'll are only gonna play this for a few hours and never finish the campaign don't get it. It doesn't offer much replayability. There are collectibles and classes and whatnot but it doesn't offer much in terms of entertainment. The story is linear the challenges can be extremely difficult and one person can mess the whole mission for the group.
